note: USA targets are strategic and deliberately aggressive, Hutong NYC explicitly so, and Hutong Miami's GA4 target is derived from its Meta plan (monthly × 6738/4756). Read variance to target with that in mind. The USA booked 372 GA4 bookings, down 4.6 percent week on week and down 44.8 percent year on year, with all three venues below target and below last year. Aqua NYC is the clearest signal: users are 2.0 percent above last year but bookings are 52.2 percent below, with conversion at 2.9 percent against 6.3 percent last year. Hutong NYC fell 20.3 percent week on week to 110, its lowest week in the eight shown, while Hutong Miami recovered to 79 from 54, although its users are 47.9 percent below last year. Year to date the portfolio sits 50.7 percent behind a target that assumed growth. The Google Reserve to OpenTable shift at both US Hutongs is a routing and margin change, not lost demand. The covers report carries the fuller picture.
